title: Western Blotting for Neuronal Proteins
author: Mukesh Kumar
materials: Normalize the protein concentration of all samples.
Dilute the primary antibodies in LiCor blocking buffer according to the manufacturer’s instructions.

Capture chemiluminescent signals using the LiCor Odyssey Fc system. •Ensure all steps are performed on ice during protein extraction to prevent protein degradation. •Optimize antibody dilutions and incubation times for specific targets. •Blotting-Grade Blocker (Bio-Rad, 1706404) can be used in place of LiCor blocking buffer. •Handle all reagents and equipment following standard laboratory safety protocols.

steps.title: Isolate and Plate Neurons
steps.instruction: Isolate neurons from rat pups (P0-1 days) and plate them on 35 mm dishes coated with 50 ug/ml poly-D-lysine.

steps.title: Culture Neurons
steps.instruction: Culture the neurons under standard conditions (37 °C, 5% CO₂) and allow them to adhere.

steps.title: Transduce Neurons with Lentivirus
steps.instruction: Introduce lentivirus into the culture media at 2 days in vitro (DIV-2) and incubate to ensure efficient transduction.

substeps.instruction: Use an appropriate multiplicity of infection (MOI) tested previously for the individual virus prepared.
Incubate the neurons with lentivirus for 48:00:00 - 72:00:00.

steps.title: Lyse Neurons
steps.instruction: Harvest the neurons and lyse them using RIPA buffer.

substeps.instruction: Remove the culture media and rinse neurons gently with ice-cold PBS.
Add RIPA lysis buffer (supplemented with complete protease inhibitor) to the dish.
Scrape the neurons into the lysis buffer using a cell scraper.

steps.title: Prepare Protein Lysate
steps.instruction: Process the lysate to isolate the cytosolic protein fraction.

substeps.instruction: Transfer the lysate to a microcentrifuge tube and incubate on ice for 00:20:00.
Centrifuge the lysate at 14000 rpm, 4 °C, for 15 minutes to remove debris.
Transfer the supernatant (cytosolic protein fraction) to a new tube.

steps.title: Quantify and Denature Proteins
steps.instruction: Measure protein concentration and prepare samples for electrophoresis.

substeps.instruction: Measure protein concentration using the BCA Protein Assay Kit according to the manufacturer’s instructions.
Mix equal amounts of protein with SDS sample buffer (2X).
Heat at 95 °C for 00:05:00 to denature the proteins.

steps.title: Run SDS-PAGE and Transfer
steps.instruction: Separate proteins by electrophoresis and transfer to a membrane.

substeps.instruction: Load the samples onto an SDS-PAGE gel and run electrophoresis at the appropriate voltage.
Transfer the separated proteins onto a PVDF membrane using a wet transfer system.

steps.title: Block Membrane
steps.instruction: Block the PVDF membrane in LiCor blocking buffer for 01:00:00 at Room temperature with gentle agitation.

steps.title: Primary Antibody Incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate the membrane with the primary antibody overnight at 4 °C with gentle rocking.

steps.title: Wash Membrane After Primary Antibody
steps.instruction: Wash the membranes 3 times with TBST (Tris-buffered saline with 0.1% Tween-20), 10 minutes per wash.

steps.title: Secondary Antibody Incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate the membrane with HRP-conjugated secondary antibody.

substeps.instruction: Dilute HRP-conjugated secondary antibody in LiCor blocking buffer.
Incubate the membrane for 01:00:00 at Room temperature.

steps.title: Wash Membrane After Secondary Antibody
steps.instruction: Wash the membrane 3 times with TBST, 10 minutes per wash.

steps.title: Detect Proteins
steps.instruction: Apply ECL reagent to the PVDF membrane.

steps.title: Final Membrane Washes
steps.instruction: Perform final washes of the membrane with TBST (Tris-buffered saline with 0.1% Tween-20).

substeps.instruction: Wash the membranes 3 times for 00:10:00 each.
Wash the membrane an additional 3 times for 00:10:00 each.
